Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established role and take a leading scientific role in shaping the analytical development capabilities.

**Lead complex Analytical Development across a growing development pipeline

**As Principal Analytical Development Chemist at Pharmacosmos, you will serve as the Analytical Lead across CMC development programs, driving analytical development, characterization, control strategies, and regulatory readiness from early-stage development through commercialization to lifecycle activities.

In this high impact role, you will be responsible for driving analytical development and ensuring that robust analytical methods, specifications, stability strategies, and control frameworks are established to support successful product development, regulatory submissions, and commercial manufacturing. You will apply your scientific expertise to complex analytical challenges, including product characterization, impurity profiling, method development, method qualification, validation strategy, comparability assessments, and technical investigations, helping to de-risk development programs and accelerate progress.

Working closely with Drug Substance Leads, Drug Product Leads, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and external development partners, you will provide strategic guidance and scientific leadership across the organization. You will oversee analytical activities performed both internally and through CROs, CDMOs, and specialist laboratories, ensuring high-quality execution, sound scientific decision-making, and timely delivery of project objectives.

Beyond supporting individual projects, you will contribute to strengthening Pharmacosmos' analytical capabilities by advancing laboratory technologies, scientific best practices, and knowledge sharing across teams. As a trusted technical expert, you will mentor colleagues, influence key decisions, and help build a culture of scientific excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Highly skilled Analytical Development Chemist with strong project management capabilities

**We are seeking a highly qualified candidate with an MSc or PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical industry, typically gained over 10 years or more, and possess a strong track record within analytical development ideally across both drug substance and drug product development. You have in-depth experience with analytical characterization, method development, qualification, and transfer, as well as specification setting, stability programs, impurity characterization, and analytical control strategies. Experience working with CROs, CDMOs, external laboratories, and cross-functional CMC teams is essential, together with a solid understanding of regulatory requirements and CMC documentation. You are an established scientific leader who can independently drive complex analytical activities and influence decision-making through technical expertise and sound scientific judgment.

You are a scientifically driven and highly analytical professional who thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You combine deep technical expertise with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset and are motivated by solving complex challenges and advancing pharmaceutical development programs. You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and communicate complex scientific topics with clarity and credibility. Through strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement, you create alignment across functions and external partners while maintaining focus on quality, timelines, and business objectives. You are structured, proactive, and resilient, with a strong sense of integrity and accountability, and you enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of scientific excellence and continuous improvement. Finally, you are fluent in English, both written and verbal.

**Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

**This is your chance to embark upon a personal and organizational journey in a dynamic company where your know-how is greatly needed for the future development of Pharmacosmos. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on our foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, we develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA. Learn more about Pharmacosmos at www.pharmacosmos.com.

The Company

COWI is a leading international consultancy within engineering, architecture, energy, and the environment. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects - From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. • A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process on behalf of COWI and will treat all applications with confidentiality. Please apply by clicking Easy Apply here on LinkedIn.

To learn more about Best Talent please visit www.besttalent.dk.

jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. 

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.

You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. 

Your tasks & responsibilities 
As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.

Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.

In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

• Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
• Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
• Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
• Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
• Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
• Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.

Your profile & qualifications 

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. 

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 

• Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
• Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
• Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
• Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
• Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
• Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.

Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems
 Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  
 The Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN); Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as full Professor within the area of microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems.

  Research and teaching at PLEN covers topics within Agriculture, Plant Science, Biotechnology, Biosolutions and Environmental Sciences, dealing with a wide range of subjects focusing especially on plants, soil, and microorganisms from molecules through organisms to populations and anthropogenic ecosystems. It is our vision to maintain and develop our position as one of the leading departments for plant science and the related areas based on excellent basic and applied research.

  The department hosts state-of-the art infrastructure and unique field research facilities, with many opportunities for collaborations across the department. The department is organised into four sections, and the appointed professor will be affiliated to the section of Environmental Sciences located at the Frederiksberg campus.

  The section of Environmental Sciences carries out world-leading research across diverse disciplines, including soil microbiology, chemistry, agrohydrology, ecotoxicology, to assess and mitigate human impacts on ecosystems. By combining measurements, experiments, and modelling, the section supports both basic environmental science and applied solutions for sustainable agriculture, climate mitigation, and clean soil and water. The section of Environmental Sciences conducts world-leading research covering environmental biology, chemistry, and ecosystem science. Focusing on agroecosystems and impacts on soil, water, and the atmosphere, the section connects fundamental discoveries to solutions for targeting climate impacts, microbial diversity, and toxicological challenges.

  The professor is expected to teach both at the BSc and MSc levels primarily in the Biotechnology and the Natural resources and Environmental Sciences programmes at the Frederiksberg Campus and to expand these regular teaching commitments to the new MSc in Biosolutions in Kalundborg.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Description of qualifications needed

  The professorship is advertised within the area of microbial solutions for climate-friendly and sustainable production systems. Full exploitation of these solutions requires basic understanding of the complex interactions in the environment which shape microbial communities and their functions in soil and at the plant root interface.

  Hence, the appointed professor should have a broad knowledge of microbial ecology including microbial functioning under soil conditions, drivers for microbiome assembly as well as microbe-microbe and plant-microbe interactions of importance for soil and plant health. It is expected that the professor has a recognized international position in the field and contributes to the design and implementation of new methodologies within microbial ecology. The successful candidate is expected to drive research within:

   	
• Model system development for causality and mechanistic understanding of microbial functioning under natural soil conditions 	
• The microbial component of N and P nutrition in agricultural systems 	
• Drivers for root colonization and microbial assembly in agricultural systems 	
• Microbial functions of importance for soil health and functioning 	
• Microbial solutions for climate mitigation and sustainable plant production   The appointed professor is expected to cover teaching in existing courses both at the MSc and BSc levels in subjects related to microbiology, molecular genetics and biotechnology. Likewise, the appointed professor is expected to be a driver for the development of courses to ensure high-quality teaching in a constantly changing educational landscape. Supervision of BSc and MSc projects is expected on a regular basis. International candidates are expected to be able to contribute actively to teaching in Danish within 3-6 years, including supervision and assessment of students. Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

  The candidate should fulfil the following criteria:

   	
• PhD or similar in molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, or a related field 	
• Profound experience in the study of plant microbe-related issues in the context of sustainable agriculture 	
• An excellent publication record that includes corresponding-author, senior author and first author publications of relevance to the position and demonstrate an impact on the scientific field of microbial interactions related to soils, plants and the environment 	
• Proven leadership in an academic research environment and ability to guide an independent research group to achieve specific goals 	
• Extensive experience in the development, organization, restructuring, and management of courses at BSc and MSc levels, supported by a comprehensive teaching portfolio that documents pedagogic competences and ongoing skills development. 	
• Extensive experience with supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students, as well as postdocs 	
• A teaching portfolio that documents teaching experience and reflections on teaching skills 	
• Documented ability to obtain independent research grants from private and public foundations. 	
• A strong track record of successful external/international collaborations. 	
• Documented experience in organizational tasks such as departmental committees 	
• Experience with outreach activities and communication of research to the public and stakeholders via, e.g., popular science events, press releases, interviews, conferences etc 	
• Societal impact in terms of participation in appropriate stakeholder networks   Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf
 
 Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  
 Salary and employment conditions

  The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.   There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Further information on the department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department Morten Petersen (morten.petersen@plen.ku.dk).

  
 Filing of application
 The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers    

  The deadline for applications is 8 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 18 March 2027.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**
